name: Marble Room, Black Square
desc1: Standing upon a large slab of colored marble, you find yourself in a
desc2: massive chamber. You see nothing of the ceiling above, save for a pale
desc3: light that shines from an unknown source. You notice the floor around
desc4: you is an alternating shade of white and black marble, each one a
desc5: different colour then the next. You vaguely see other shapes in the
desc6: darkness but can not make out what they appear.
